title: MEMORY CHIP STOCKS ARE CRASHING: HERE IS THE TRUTH
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: China's CXMT and Toshiba news raise fear of memory oversupply undercutting Micron, SK Hynix, Samsung, SanDisk.
Over-leveraged Korean retail in the KOSPI (Samsung, SK Hynix) is amplifying the semiconductor selloff.
Markets overbought and expected to de-risk ahead of CPI this week; still a bullish trend of higher highs and higher lows.

calls.reason: Pullback after a huge run and memory-cycle/oversupply fears, but fundamentally undervalued at ~13x P/E with large profits.
calls.quote: Fundamentally speaking, Micron is a very possibly undervalued company.

calls.reason: Overbought Nasdaq likely to de-risk into CPI; overall trend still higher highs and higher lows, so only a slight pullback.
calls.quote: Nasdaq's overbought. CPI data report is this week. It's expected that markets were most likely going to de-risk.

notes: Recorded during overnight session after the cash close. Micron down ~12.6% from 1,100 high; MU short-term bias is the ongoing pullback, long-term he says don't sell.
